description:
Activate Berta by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Rosie Cotton and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Rosie Cotton trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.
